trello.name: Implement Queue Depth Alerting
trello.desc: Set up alerting on queue depth for the payment workers with a warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and a paging threshold at 5,000. Apply the same alerts across the entire worker fleet. Assigned to Kofi.

trello.name: Fix Retry Logic in Payment Worker
trello.desc: Update the retry logic in the payment worker. Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and redirect failed jobs to a dead-letter queue instead of the front of the main queue. Add tests to simulate processor 503s. Assigned to Marta.

trello.name: Increase and Separate DB Connection Pool
trello.desc: Increase the database connection pool size to 100 and separate the worker and API pools to prevent resource exhaustion. Both changes to be made in the same configuration file. Assigned to Kofi.

trello.name: Update Payment Incident Runbook
trello.desc: Revise the payment incident runbook to include new logging links, document the queue drain procedure, and verify all escalation phone numbers are current. Assigned to Priya, confirmation required by Kofi.

trello.name: Automate Status Page Update
trello.desc: Automate the status page updates to trigger when the checkout error rate alert fires. Initially wire it to the checkout alert, with possible extensions later. Assigned to Marta.

trello.name: Plan Payment Processor Failover Test
trello.desc: Organize a game day for testing the payment processor failover in staging and then in production during a low-traffic window. Include a rollback plan. Draft the plan first and review it in two weeks before execution. Assigned to Kofi.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis to Version 7.2
trello.desc: Migrate Redis from version 6.0 to 7.2 due to end-of-life status. Ensure a proper change window is scheduled due to configuration and persistence changes. Assigned to Kofi.
